name: Swipe Toast
description: Toast notification card that slides in, burns down a fuse line timer, and can be dismissed by swiping down, with optional action and close buttons. Fixed to the corner or placed inline.
contents: Toast card with title, optional description and optional icon
Optional action button and optional close button
Fuse line progress bar along the bottom or top edge
behavior: Slides up and fades in on mount, slides down and fades out on close
Fuse line shrinks over duration, then closes the toast with reason timeout
Drag down to dismiss by distance or flick velocity, upward drag rubber-bands and drag release springs back
Timer pauses on mouse hover, focus, active drag and hidden tab
Escape key dismisses instantly, Enter or Space then action or close skips the exit animation
Inline mode collapses its height with a grid-rows transition
Reduced motion removes slide and uses opacity only
Calls onClose with reason: timeout, action, close, escape, programmatic or swipe
editableByProps: Title, description, icon, action label and action handler
Colors for background, text and fuse line, width, corner radius
Slide speed, spring bounce, swipe distance, auto-close duration (0 disables the timer)
Fuse position, hover pause, close button, inline vs fixed, swipe dismissal, open state

needsCodeEdit.change: Change swipe direction or flick sensitivity
needsCodeEdit.where: FLICK, DEAD_ZONE and RESIST_PX constants and the onPointerMove handler

needsCodeEdit.change: Move the fixed toast to another corner
needsCodeEdit.where: data-[inline=false]:right-8 and bottom classes on the root div
EASE_OUT constant and the cubic-bezier values in the root classes
HugeiconsIcon with Cancel01Icon in the close button

fixed: Not a toast manager: renders a single toast and the host must handle stacking, queueing and unmounting
Requires 'use client' and the motion and @hugeicons packages
Non-inline mode is position fixed at the bottom right of the viewport with very high z-index, 32px offset (16px under 600px) and width capped to the viewport
Only downward swipe dismisses, upward drag is resisted
Uses Web Animations API and CSS starting-style, with a requestAnimationFrame fallback
Adds document visibilitychange listener while mounted
Works on small screens, card width shrinks to fit the viewport
